title: Sports radio to try in Malta
intro: The strongest radio leads found for 13–19 October are NET FM on FM 101 MHz, plus DAB+ directory listings for Radio Sportiva and BBC World Service. WorldDAB (a specialist technical directory) lists BBC World Service on Digi B Network block 6A at 181.936 MHz; reception at AX ODYCY and the event venue remains untested. BBC’s dated Sportsworld broadcasts (17–18 October) and Radio Sportiva’s recurring Diretta Sportiva grid overlap the kickoff windows of EPL and Serie A fixtures listed on Kalshi for 16–18 October, but neither broadcaster has published a match-by-match commentary list for those dates, no Malta radio carriage was confirmed for CS2/TWC, Gżira United–Mosta, or the Rolex Middle Sea Race, and Kalshi trading access from Malta is not assumed.

records.name: NET FM — FM 101 MHz
records.area: Nationwide licensed FM service in Malta
records.hours: NET FM’s recurring weekly grid lists Hits & Score on Saturday at 16:00 and Sports Box on Sunday at 15:00 (times as published by the Malta station; timezone not explicitly stated). In this trip window those days are 17 and 18 October.
records.description: The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations list gives NET FM at 101 MHz FM. NET FM’s own recurring weekend grid includes two sports programmes. This is the clearest conventional-FM option found, but the weekly grid is not a date-stamped October 2026 schedule and does not confirm match commentary or carriage of a particular event.
records.notes: NET FM’s official programme grid: https://netfm.com.mt/. The frequency is from the Broadcasting Authority; the programme names/times are from the station. The grid does not state its time zone and is recurring, not a date-stamped trip-week schedule. Recheck the station’s live schedule before travel. No TWC, Gżira United–Mosta, or Rolex Middle Sea Race radio carriage was confirmed.

records.name: Radio Sportiva — DAB+ directory listing
records.area: Malta DAB+ directory; reception not tested at AX ODYCY or BLAST Arena Studios
records.address: Not published; the directory does not state a multiplex block or tuned frequency
records.hours: Radio Sportiva’s recurring grid lists Diretta Sp.+Calciom. Mon–Fri 15:05–17:00 and Diretta Sportiva Sat–Sun 15:05–17:00. Its official schedule note says programming may vary with the day’s sporting events and live coverage can run until 24:00 for early/late big matches in Serie A, Serie B, Coppa Italia, European Cups, National Team, F1, MotoGP, or other major sports. When rechecked on 11 October, the dated Sportiva Live banner still covered 5–11 October rather than 13–19 October.
records.description: Digi B Network’s Malta DAB+ channel directory lists Radio Sportiva, an Italian sports station. Radio Sportiva’s own schedule lists daily and weekend sports programming and notes that live coverage varies with major Serie A, European Cup, F1, and MotoGP events. The Digi B channel profile is dated 2020 and gives no current technical reception details, so treat it as a plausible DAB+ option to scan for by station name, not as a reception test or a promise of live coverage of a named match.
records.notes: DAB+ channel list: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. The Broadcasting Authority identifies DigiB Network as the licensed digital-radio service provider: https://ba.org.mt/licence-applications. The provider’s site says DAB+ sets tune by service name: https://dab.com.mt/. Station’s official schedule (rechecked 11 October 2026) and its note that live coverage can extend to 24:00 for Serie A, Serie B, Coppa Italia, European Cups, National Team, F1, and MotoGP: https://www.radiosportiva.com/palinsesto/. The Radio Sportiva channel profile is dated 20 August 2020; no current block/frequency or on-location reception test was found. Times are as published; Italy and Malta share the same civil time (CEST, UTC+2) during this trip.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked

records.name: BBC World Service — DAB+ listing and Sportsworld dates
records.area: BBC World Service appears in Malta’s DAB+ channel directory; reception not tested locally
records.address: Not published; this is a broadcast listing, not a visitor venue
records.hours: BBC’s official Sportsworld upcoming-broadcasts page lists Saturday 17 October at 13:06 GMT (duration 3 hours, 53 minutes) and Sunday 18 October at 14:06 GMT (duration 3 hours, 53 minutes) on BBC World Service (except News Internet). That is 15:06–18:59 and 16:06–19:59 Malta time respectively (CEST, UTC+2).
records.description: The Malta DAB+ channel directory includes BBC World Service. BBC’s Sportsworld upcoming-broadcasts page describes its live coverage as including the English Premier League (EPL) and schedules 3-hour-53-minute Sportsworld editions on both playoff-weekend dates (17 and 18 October). However, the dated 17 and 18 October episode pages do not yet name which specific EPL fixtures will have full live commentary, and neither directory evidence nor the programme schedule proves indoor reception at the traveler’s locations or commentary on the trip’s esports, Maltese football, or sailing events.
records.notes: Malta DAB+ directory listing for BBC World Service: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. BBC Sportsworld home and EPL programme description: https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/p002w5vq and https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c9208pxyf8 . Dated BBC episode pages (rechecked 11 October 2026; each lists a 3-hour-53-minute duration): Saturday 17 October, https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0m2cw ; Sunday 18 October, https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0q313. The schedule labels the feed “BBC World Service except News Internet”; the episode page’s displayed local clock depends on the viewer’s time zone. Times above are converted from 13:06 and 14:06 GMT to 15:06 and 16:06 Malta time (UTC+2). No reception test at AX ODYCY or MFCC was available.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required for radio reception; hardware price not checked

records.name: BBC World Service — Malta DAB+ operator & multiplex frequency listing
records.area: Malta Digi B Network listing; reception at AX ODYCY and MFCC not tested
records.address: Not published; this is a technical radio-service listing, not a venue
records.hours: Technical service-directory entry; not a programme schedule
records.description: Malta’s licensed DAB+ operator Digi B Network lists BBC World Service in its official channel directory, without stating a block or frequency on that page. Separately, the specialist technical directory WorldDAB lists BBC World Service on Digi B Network block 6A at 181.936 MHz. Directory entries are for tuning/scanning only, not a measured signal-strength result or a guarantee of reliable reception indoors at the hotel or event venue.
records.notes: Official Digi B Network channel list: https://dab.com.mt/channels/ (licensed operator per Broadcasting Authority: https://ba.org.mt/licence-applications). Specialist/third-party technical directories (not the local operator or an on-location reception test): WorldDAB’s Malta multiplex directory lists BBC WS on Digi B Network block 6A at 181.936 MHz, https://www.worlddab.org/why-dab-plus/countries/malta/multiplexes ; Wohnort lists transmission sites at Għargħur and Żebbuġ (Gozo), https://www.wohnort.org/dab/malta.html. No receiver scan at AX ODYCY or the MFCC was available; actual reception remains unknown.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked

records.description: No current AM or medium-wave sports station was confirmed in the sources checked. A 2026 TVM News history says Radju Malta began on 999 MW and changed to 93.7 FM in 1979; that historic 999 MW reference is not evidence of a current AM service.
records.notes: The current Broadcasting Authority licensed-stations list was checked for current AM/MW sports carriage; it lists licensed FM and DAB services but no current AM sports schedule. Historical frequency context: https://tvmnews.mt/en/news/radju-malta-is-53-years-old/. The absence of a listing is not a guarantee that no distant AM signal can ever be received; do not rely on an AM sports programme without current station confirmation.
